title: Araghchi Meets with OIC Secretary-General
text:
Araghchi Meets with OIC Secretary-General"

"🔆🔅BAGHDAD, October17, 2026 -- Abbas Araghchi, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Iran, met and held talks with Ismail Ould Cheikh Ahmed, Secretary-General of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC), on the evening of Saturday, 17 October 2026, continuing his consultations on the sidelines of the 52nd Session of the OIC Council of Foreign Ministers.
